requirements.title: I editing field width, input-width restriction, effective item type, and related descriptors
requirements.definition: I w and I w.m edit fields occupy w positions except that w=0 lets the processor select output width; w shall not be zero on input; the effective item shall be integer, enum type, or enumeration type; G/B/O/Z can also edit integer data.
